finding: Cord blood adiponectin concentration at birth was positively associated with birth size and negatively associated with weight gain in the first year of life, while maternal serum adiponectin during pregnancy was positively associated with postnatal height growth.
mod_finding: Maternal serum adiponectin during pregnancy may predict postnatal height growth, while cord blood adiponectin is associated with infant birth size and weight gain in the first year after adjusting for mode of delivery.
